name: Kopeechnyj Svidetel'
source:
An ordinary student, Constantine, suddenly finds himself drawn into a courtroom drama.
To make sense of what happened and to influence the course of the trial, he must retrace every step of his recent, unplanned journey to nowhere — a road that became much more than just a trip.
Along the way, he faces memories of friendship and betrayal, moments of romance and danger, and above all, a trial of his own values and convictions.
